name: Add
description: Adds two floating-point numbers. The Blueprint Add node is variadic: drag additional input pins to sum more than two values. Returns the sum of all connected inputs.

inputs.name: A
inputs.description: First addend. Connect a float variable, a literal number, or the output of any node returning a float.

inputs.name: B
inputs.description: Second addend. Connect a float variable, a literal number, or the output of any node returning a float.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: The sum A + B (+ any additional C, D, ... pins added by dragging the node).
